investigation.initial_observation: Seed, four workers, keep_models=false: GNU time median +34.6%, internal monotonic scan median +34.5%. One unrelated GNU time elapsed sample was negative (-1.92 seconds).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transient host scheduling or CPU load
hypotheses.prediction: Fresh alternating pairs do not sustain the slowdown; CPU time need not rise with elapsed time.
Four-worker overhead persists in fresh pairs while one-worker results remain close.
CPU time rises consistently along with elapsed time across independent runs.

investigation.instrumentation: Collection harness now measures subprocess duration with perf_counter_ns and records GNU time user/system CPU time. It retains raw GNU time wall time and process peak RSS plus the probe internal Instant duration. No scanner instrumentation or source changes.
investigation.full_monotonic_matrix_observation: The original seed/four-worker/no-retention case was +2.0%; seed/four-worker/retained models was +10.2% and was separately investigated.
investigation.decision: Retain implementation. Neither flagged case reproduced above the investigation threshold in eleven alternating pairs. Median CPU time was unchanged; the retained-model repeat had identical median internal scan time and +4.8% process duration. Transient load is consistent with these results but its cause is not established. No speedup is claimed.

default_rationale: 256 MiB permits 8,388,608 32-byte Value slots and gives 551.5x headroom over the 486,768-byte corpus construction reservation. This generous provisional allowance leaves room for larger builtin workloads; it does not establish complete value-storage admission.
